base_video.description: Path to the talking-head spine mp4. Filled in by the conductor if omitted.

fps.description: Output frame rate. The compositor forces 25 for concat-compatibility.

id.description: Moment id (m1, m2, ...); also the clip filename <id>.mp4.

start.description: Seconds into the spine to begin the cutaway.

hold.description: Cutaway duration in seconds; clamped to the generated clip's real length at compose.

source.description: t2v = motion clip (veo3.1-fast); still = image (nano-banana-2) turned into a Ken Burns clip.

mode.description: Per-moment override of the global --mode. fullframe = cover the frame; pip = corner picture-in-picture.

model.description: fal model id. Defaults by source (veo3.1-fast for t2v, nano-banana-2 for still).

prompt.description: Cinematic single-shot description fed to the fal model. No on-screen text, captions, talking people, or logos.

trigger_phrase.description: The short quote from the transcript the cutaway illustrates (used for labels/debug only).
